description: He wears an opaque deep-blue knee-length tunic with narrow gold woven geometric borders along collar, front, cuffs and hem, over a cream full-sleeved underlayer. A dark-brown long cloak with gold knotwork borders hangs from circular gold-toned shoulder brooches; two smaller circular fittings fasten the upper neckline. The brown decorated belt has a large round buckle and long metal-ornamented hanging end. Brown trousers tuck into tall cross-strapped brown boots. Tunic and cloak appear wool-like with linen-like pale layers; exact fibers are uncertain. No headgear, weapon or armor is visible.
